content_sections.heading: About GBPNIHE
content_sections.text: G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (GBPNIHE) is an institute located at Kosi-Katarmal, Almora 263643, Uttarakhand. This post is meant for the institute's own medical support: the selected person will work with the Doctor/Medical officer in the Institute Dispensary and attend residents and staff of the Institute in medical emergencies round the clock.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from Indian citizens. The eligibility printed for the post is: Age limit: 45 Years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Experience proof: experience will not be considered without an experience certificate. Relaxation for outstanding candidates: the minimum requirements of qualifications and/or experience can be relaxed in respect of exceptionally outstanding candidates. Residence: the staff member must reside within the Institute's residential premises to ensure 24-hour availability. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor/ Diploma in Nursing / Pharmacy with minimum 5 years experience in the relevant field
rows.desirable: Preference will be given to the Woman/ Ex-serviceman candidates

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Nursing Assistant/ Pharmacist post carries Rs 20,000/- per month, fixed. The notice describes it as a contractual-based temporary position and states that the engagement is purely temporary in nature. No period of engagement is specified in the notice. The staff member will bear the prescribed nominal charges for residential facilities within the Institute's premises. The Institute reserves the right to disengage the manpower at any time without assigning any reasons. The selected candidate(s) are expected to join immediately. The selected candidate is liable to be posted anywhere in India.

content_sections.heading: GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these duties and responsibilities for the Nursing Assistant/ Pharmacist: To perform regular duties of nursing assistant/pharmacist. To assist Doctor/Medical officer in the Institute Dispensary. To assist/attend residents/staffs of the Institute in the 24-hour medical emergency. Any other duties assigned by Institute Dispensary Incharge/ Medical officer.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Submit the application through the online recruitment portal at https://gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php only; the portal is the only route named in the notice. Complete the online application on or before 11:59 PM on 2 December 2026. In the application, mention all qualifications and experience in the relevant field over and above the minimum prescribed qualification, supported with documents. Attend the walk-in interview on 4 December 2026 from 10:00 am at GBPNIHE, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora (Uttarakhand); the interview is only for candidates who have completed the online application form. Original documents of educational qualifications. Original documents of experience, including the experience certificate. One set of photocopies of these documents.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview held on 4 December 2026 from 10:00 am at GBPNIHE, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora (Uttarakhand). Candidates appearing for the interview physically must bring the original documents listed above with one set of photocopies. Meeting the minimum advertised qualification and experience does not automatically entitle an applicant to be called for an Interview/ Test(s). If the number of applications received is large, the institute reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility level to restrict the number of candidates called for interview/ test. The Institute may shortlist and select candidates in any suitable position depending on the qualification and experience required. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of positions, or to fill up or not to fill up any or all the posts. In case of any dispute or ambiguity in the selection process, the decision of the Institute on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection and conduct of examination/ interview will be final, and no query or correspondence will be entertained. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Nursing Assistant/ Pharmacist (Post Code HQ 26-27-2301) under Advt. No. NIHE/HQ-23/26-27.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the GBPNIHE Nursing Assistant/ Pharmacist post?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted on or before 11:59 PM on 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the GBPNIHE Nursing Assistant/ Pharmacist post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor/ Diploma in Nursing / Pharmacy with minimum 5 years experience in the relevant field is required. Experience is counted only with an experience certificate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the GBPNIHE Nursing Assistant/ Pharmacist post?
faq.answer: The notice prints the age limit as 45 Years, without a cut-off date or category-wise relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the GBPNIHE Nursing Assistant/ Pharmacist?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs 20,000/- per month, fixed.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply only through the online recruitment portal at https://gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php by 11:59 PM on 2 December 2026, then attend the walk-in interview on 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the GBPNIHE walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 4 December 2026 from 10:00 am at GBPNIHE, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora (Uttarakhand), only for candidates who have completed the online application form.

faq.question: Q8. Is the GBPNIHE Nursing Assistant/ Pharmacist post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a contractual-based position, and the notice states the engagement is purely temporary; the Institute may disengage the manpower at any time without assigning reasons.

faq.question: Q9. Does the selected GBPNIHE Nursing Assistant/ Pharmacist have to live on campus?
faq.answer: Yes. The staff member must reside within the Institute's residential premises to ensure 24-hour availability and will bear the prescribed nominal charges for the residential facilities.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets preference in GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to the Woman/ Ex-serviceman candidates for the Nursing Assistant/ Pharmacist post.
